section: Social Studies · Ch48 — Indian & World Geography
subject: Social Studies
stem: India receives the majority of its annual rainfall (June to September) from winds blowing from the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal toward the land, a season known as the:
explanation: The Southwest Monsoon (June-September) brings moisture-laden winds from the sea onto land, delivering most of India's annual rainfall — the Northeast Monsoon (October-December) instead brings winds from land to sea, causing rainfall mainly on India's southeastern (Tamil Nadu) coast as it picks up moisture crossing the Bay of Bengal.

section: Social Studies · Ch48 — Indian & World Geography
subject: Social Studies
stem: The Earth's landmass is conventionally divided into how many continents?

options.option_text: Seven (Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, Australia)

explanation: The conventional seven-continent model is Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, and Australia (Oceania) — some geographic models combine Europe and Asia into 'Eurasia', yielding a six-continent count, but the seven-continent model is most commonly taught.
